_comment: List prices in USD per million tokens, in the same shape as pi's models-store.json.
Bundled because Claude Code reports no cost at all — without this every phase it
runs prices at $0 and reads as free next to a metered pi phase. pi's registry wins
on key collision; CRAFT_METRICS_PRICES overrides both.
cacheRead is 0.1x input; cacheWrite is the 5-minute-TTL rate, 1.25x input. The 1h TTL
costs 2x, and the store cannot tell the two apart from aggregate counts — so notional
is a floor on cache-heavy phases, matching how pricing.ts already treats Codex tiers.
claude-sonnet-5 is priced at its $3/$15 list rate, not the $2/$10 introductory rate
running through 2026-08-31: notional is what the tokens are worth at list price, and a
promotional rate would make phases measured during the promo incomparable to later ones.
Source: the claude-api skill's model table, checked 2026-08-28.
